title.en: 2.1 Circuit breaker: function, parts and mechanism
title.gu: 2.1 Circuit Breaker: Function, Parts તથા Mechanism

h.en: Circuit breaker: function, parts and mechanism
h.gu: Circuit Breaker: Function, Parts તથા Mechanism

body.en:
Definition

A circuit breaker is a rated switching device able to make, carry and interrupt normal and specified abnormal currents, including short-circuit duty under stated conditions.

Classification / scope

  • By interrupting medium: oil, air, SF6, vacuum; HVDC is a system-duty class realised by special mechanical, semiconductor or hybrid designs.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • It is not merely an isola tor.Abreaker interrupts current; safe maintenance isolation/earthing still needs the approved disconnector/permit process.
  • Fixed/moving conta cts, arc-control chamber, insulation, terminals, drive linkage, trip/close coils, energy-storage mechanism and auxiliary conta cts form a practical breaker.
  • Spring, pneumatic or hydraulic drives store operating energy; trip-free and anti-pumping functions prevent unsafe sustained closing commands from defeating a trip.
  • Breaker status indication is distinct from all-pole current extinction; pole discrepancy, mechanism alarms and trip-circuit health require checks.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Circuit breaker normal તથા specified abnormal/short-circuit currents ને rated conditions માં make, carry/interrupt કરી શકે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Medium: oil, air, SF6, vacuum; HV DC system-duty class છે, special mechanical/semiconductor/hybrid design થી.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • CB માત્ર isola tor નથી; current interrupt કરે, maintenance માટે approved isolation/earth/permit હજી જોઈએ.
  • Fixed/movingconta cts, arc chamber, insulation, terminals, linkage, trip-close coils, energy mechanism/auxconta cts parts છે.
  • Spring/pneumatic/hydraulic energy; trip-free/anti-pumping થી sustained close command trip ને defeat નકરે.
  • Status/all-pole current extinction જુદાં; pole discrepancy/mechanism/trip health જુઓ.

h.en: Arc voltage, interruption and fault-clearing time
h.gu: Arc Voltage, Interruption તથા Fault-clearing Time

body.en:
Definition

An arc is a conducting ionised path that can sustain current after conta cts separate; successful interruption extinguishes it and prevents re-establishment under the recovering voltage.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Arc voltage depends on medium, length, cooling, pressure and current; energy∫varci dt heats conta cts/medium.Ahigh arc voltage is not automatically harmless.
  • High-resistance interruption raises arc resistance/voltage; current-zero methods exploit AC current zero plus rapid dielectric recovery.Modern applications use medium-specific designs.
  • System total clearing time includes relay decision, trip-circuit delay, mechanical opening and final arcing time.Breaker interrupting time alone excludes preceding relay time.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For an illustrative nonoverlapping timing budget, tclear=trelay+ttrip+topen+tarc.
  2. With 25 ms, 5 ms, 35 ms, 10 ms respectively, total=75 ms; the breaker-only opening-plus-arcing portion is 45 ms.Actual specifications may group timing boundaries differently.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Arc conta cts epa ration પછી current વહનકરતો ionised path છે; successful interruption તેને extinguish/voltage પાછુંઆવેત્યારે re strike અટકાવે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Arc Vmedium, length, cooling, pressure/I પર; ∫varci dt energy heat આપે; high Vautomatic harmless નહીં.
  • Highresistancearc R/V વધારે; current-zero AC zero/fast dielectric recovery વાપરે; design medium-specific.
  • System time માં relay, trip delay, opening/final arc; CB interrupting time પહેલાનો relay time સમાવતું નથી.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Illustrative nonoverlapping budget માં tclear=trelay+ttrip+topen+tarc.
  2. 25 ms/5 ms/35 ms/10 ms થી total 75 ms/CB opening+arc 45 ms; actual specification માં boundaries જુદાંહોઈશકે.

title.en: 2.2 Restriking/recovery voltage, TRV and resistance switching
title.gu: 2.2 Restriking/Recovery Voltage, TRV તથા Resistance Switching

h.en: Restriking/recovery voltage, TRV and resistance switching
h.gu: Restriking/Recovery Voltage, TRV તથા Resistance Switching

body.en:
Definition

Transient recovery voltage is the time-varying voltage appearing across interrupting conta cts immediately after current interruption; dielectric recovery must withstand it without renewed conduction.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Legacy “restriking voltage” commonly refers to the fast initial transient; “recovery voltage” may describe the later power-frequency value.State the convention rather than treating all terms as identical.
  • Peak TRV and rate of rise(RRRV)depend on system L/C, fault type and source conditions; breaker suitability needs the specified TRV envelope, not only RMS fault current.
  • Aproperly designed resistance-switching path damps the L/Ctransient and lowers voltage stress during interruption; the resistor then needs its own switching/energy rating.This differs from closing pre-insertion resistors.
  • Re strikes, capacitive current switching and inductive current chopping are application-specific stresses; never estimate a complete TRV duty from one linear slope.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. A simple LC natural frequency is f 0=1/(2π√LC), not a complete breaker TRV specification.
  2. For L=1m H, C=0.1µF, f 0≈15.92k Hz; an illustrative 100k Vrise in 50µs has average slope 2k V/µs, not necessarily peak RRRV.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

TRV currentinterrupt પછી conta cts across નું time-varying voltage છે; dielectric recovery તેને re strike વિનાસહેવી જોઈએ.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Legacy restriking fast initial transient/recovery later power-frequency માટેવપરાય; convention સ્પષ્ટરાખો.
  • Peak TRV/RRRV system L-C, fault/source પર; RMSI એકલુંસૂટેબિલિટી proof નથી.
  • Designedresistancepath L-Ctransientdamp કરે; resistor energy/switching rating જોઈએ; closing pre-insertion થીજુદું.
  • Re strike, capacitive/current chopping application-specific; એક slope થી complete TRV duty નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Simple LC frequencyf 0=1/(2π√LC), complete TRV spec નહીં.
  2. L 1m H/C 0.1µF માં f 0≈15.92k Hz; 100k V/50µsaverageslope 2k V/µs, peak RRRV જરૂરીનહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Interruption resistance switching temporarily provides a designed damping path across the interrupting gap so network transient energy is controlled during the switching sequence.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Main interrupting conta cts are shunted by a resistor plus controlled auxiliary switching path; both paths require insulation/sequence coordination.

Working / operating sequence

  1. During main interruption, the resistor path damps the network L/Ctransient and reduces the intended recovery-voltage stress.
  2. The resistor still carries current/absorbs energy; the auxiliary path must then interrupt/remove it in the designed sequence.
  3. Failure to remove the path or incorrect timing can overheat the resistor or defeat isolation; never improvise it across a real breaker.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • This conceptual shunt path is not the same duty as a resistor inserted during line closing; actual resistance, insulation, energy and auxiliary interruption ratings are engineered.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Interruption resistance switching માં gap ની across temporary designed damping path આપીને switching transient energy નિયંત્રિત કરાય છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Main conta cts ની across resistor તથા controlled auxiliary path હોય; બંને paths નું insulation/sequence coordinate કરવું પડે.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Main interruption વખતે resistor network L/C transient damp કરીને intended recovery-voltage stress ઘટાડે છે.
  2. Resistor current વહન/energy absorb કરે છે; પછી auxiliary path designed sequence થી દૂર કરવો પડે.
  3. Path દૂર ન થાય/ખોટી timing થી resistor overheat/isolation fail થઈ શકે; real breaker પર improvisation નહીં.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • આ shunt path line-closing pre-insertion resistor થી જુદું duty ધરાવે છે; R/insulation/energy/auxiliary interruption engineered હોય છે.

title.en: 2.3 Oil circuit breakers: bulk and minimum oil
title.gu: 2.3 Oil Circuit Breakers: Bulk તથા Minimum Oil

h.en: Oil circuit breakers: bulk and minimum oil
h.gu: Oil Circuit Breakers: Bulk તથા Minimum Oil

body.en:
Definition

An oil circuit breaker uses insulating oil within its designed interrupting system to cool/deionise the arc and recover insulation after interruption.

Classification / scope

  • Bulk-oil and minimum-oil; construction and rated duty determine the actual arc-control method.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Conta cts inside an oil-filled interrupting chamber with arc-control passages, insulating supports, tank/seals and operating linkage.
  2. Fixed contact is anchored to the terminal/support; moving contact conne cts to a rod driven by stored-energy mechanism, with main/arcing duty arranged by the design.
  3. Insulating clearances, bushings and tank earthing control the electric field; the oil level must maintain intended insulation and arc-chamber conditions.
  4. Arc-control pot/passages confine and direct the gas/oil flow; pressure relief prevents the chamber being treated as an unlimited pressure vessel.
  5. Seals, oil sampling/drain facilities and inspection provisions support maintenance only after approved isolation, discharge and fire precautions.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Trip separates conta cts, creating an arc; oil decomposition/gas and chamber flow cool the arc.
  2. Near AC current zero, the gap de ionises; recovered dielectric withstand must exceed recovery voltage before successful isolation.
  3. Trip coil releases the stored mechanism; main conta cts transfer current to the intended arcing path before final separation where the design provides it.
  4. Arc heat decomposes nearby oil, producing gas pressure and directed cooling that depends on chamber geometry and current.
  5. After current extinction, the gap must remain nonconducting while the system recovery voltage returns; contaminated oil can reduce this margin.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Bulk-oil designs use substantial oil for interruption and insulation; minimum-oil designs confine the interrupting oil with separate external insulation.
  • Oil condition, carbon deposits, moisture, conta cts, seals and mechanism health require maintenance.Fire/explosion risk and oil handling are important limitations.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Oil CB designed oil interrupting system થી arc cool/deionise કરીને insulation recover કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Bulk/minimum oil; actual arc control construction/duty મુજબ.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Oilchamberconta cts, arc passages, insulators, tank/seals/linkage.
  2. Fixed contact terminal/support સાથે સ્થિર રહે છે; moving contact stored-energy mechanism ના rod થી ચાલે છે; main/arcing duty design પ્રમાણે જુદી હોય છે.
  3. Bushings, clearances તથા tank earthing electric field નિયંત્રિત કરે છે; oil level યોગ્ય insulation તથા chamber condition જાળવે છે.
  4. Arc-control pot/passages gas/oil નો પ્રવાહ યોગ્ય દિશામાં રાખે છે; pressure relief જરૂરી છે, chamber unlimited-pressure vessel નથી.
  5. Seals, sampling/drain તથા inspection maintenance માં મદદ કરે; પહેલાં approved isolation/discharge/fire precautions જોઈએ.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Tripconta cts separate/arc; decomposition gas/flow cool કરે.
  2. AC zero એ deionise; dielectric withstand recovery V કરતાંપૂરતુંથાયતો interrupt થાય.
  3. Trip coil stored mechanism છોડે છે; design મુજબ main થી arcing path માં current transfer થાય છે.
  4. Arc heat થી oil decomposition/gas pressure થાય; chamber/current મુજબ directed cooling મળે છે.
  5. Current બંધ થયા પછી returning recovery voltage સામે gap nonconducting રહેવું જોઈએ; contaminated oil margin ઘટાડે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Bulkoil માં interruption/insulation માટેમોટો oil volume; minimum oil માં arc chamber oil/અલગ external insulation.
  • Oil carbon, moisture, conta cts, seals/mechanism maintain; fire/explosion/oil handling limitations.

body.en:
Definition

An air circuit breaker interrupts using air-based arc control; air-break and compressed-air-blast designs use different construction and operating resources.

Classification / scope

  • Air-break: arc chute in ambient-air system; air-blast: compressed-air interruption.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Air-break uses conta cts, runners, chute/splitter plates and mechanism; air-blast adds compressor/reservoir, valves, nozzles and pressure supervision.
  2. Main conta cts carry normal current; arcing conta cts/runners guide the arc away from the normal contact surfaces in an appropriate air-break design.
  3. An arc chute has heat-resistant walls and splitters; magnetic/electro dynamic action and geometry move and divide the arc.
  4. Air-blast nozzles, valves, reservoir and interlocks control the direction and availability of high-pressure air; low-pressure alarms/blocks follow the actual design.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Conta cts part and arc is driven into the designed chute or blast path.
  2. Cooling, lengthening/splitting and deionisation extinguish the arc; verify rated fault/TRV duty and mechanism pressure/energy.
  3. The mechanism rapidly separates conta cts; the arc follows the runners into the chute or the designed blast nozzle region.
  4. Arc lengthening, splitting and cooling raise resistance or assist current-zero deionisation according to the design; these are not identical methods for every voltage class.
  5. After the gap recovers, auxiliary status and mechanism readiness are checked before any permitted next operation; anti-pumping is not automatic fault-reclose permission.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • LV air-break ACB s commonly use arc runners, chutes and splitter plates; historical HV air-blast breakers use compressed air to sweep/deionise the arc.
  • Do not confuse compressed-air mechanism supply with the interrupting medium of every breaker.Maintain chute/conta cts or air-pressure system according to design.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Air CB air-based arc control વાપરે; air-break/compressed air-blast ની construction/resources જુદી છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Air-break: ambient arc chute; air-blast: compressed air interruption.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Air-breakconta cts/runners/chute/mechanism; air-blast compressor/reservoir/valves/nozzles/pressure.
  2. Main conta cts normal current વહન કરે; arcing conta cts/runners arc ને normal surfaces થી દૂર લઈ જાય છે.
  3. Arc chute માં heat-resistant walls/splitters હોય છે; magnetic action તથા geometry થી arc આગળ વધે અને વહેંચાય છે.
  4. Air-blast માં nozzle/valves/reservoir/interlocks high-pressure air નિયંત્રિત કરે; low-pressure action actual design પ્રમાણે હોય છે.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Conta cts separate/arc designed chute/blast માંજાય.
  2. Cooling, lengthening/splitting/deionisation થી arc બંધ; fault/TRV/energy verify.
  3. Mechanism conta cts ને ઝડપથી જુદાં પાડે; arc runner દ્વારા chute અથવા blast nozzle માં જાય છે.
  4. Design મુજબ lengthening/splitting/cooling resistance વધારે અથવા current-zero deionisation માં મદદ કરે; દર voltage class માં method સમાન નથી.
  5. Gap recovery પછી auxiliary status/mechanism readiness ચકાસાય; anti-pumping એટલે automatic fault-reclose permission નહીં.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • LVACB માં runners, chutes/splitters; historical HV air-blast માં compressed air.
  • Drive માટે air હોયએટલેઆ rc medium air જહોયએવુંનહીં; design મુજબ chute/pressure maintain.

h.en: SF6 breaker: gas system and environmental duties
h.gu: SF6 Breaker: Gas System તથા Environmental Duties

body.en:
Definition

An SF6 circuit breaker uses a designed gas-flow interruption system and the medium’s dielectric properties to extinguish the arc and withstand recovered voltage.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Sealed pole/enclosure, main/arcing conta cts, nozzle, puffer/self-blast chamber, drive, gas seals, density monitoring and pressure-relief provisions.
  2. Fixed/moving main and arcing conta cts separate normal-current and arc duty in designs that use both; the nozzle directs gas through the hot arc region.
  3. A puffer cylinder mechanically compresses gas; self-blast variants also exploit arc energy, so their pressure generation is not identical.
  4. Insulating enclosure, seals, gas-density monitor and relief arrangements maintain dielectric conditions; monitoring conta cts must be mapped to OEM alarm/block actions.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Main current transfers to arcing conta cts as the mechanism opens; gas flow cools the arc in the designed chamber.
  2. At current zero, the gas gap recovers insulation; low-density block/alarm/trip behaviour follows OEM limits, not a universal pressure number.
  3. As the mechanism travels, the nozzle/gas chamber establishes flow; arc energy and mechanical compression interact according to breaker variant.
  4. The cooled gap must recover quickly enough for the specified TRV; gas density, purity and contact wear affect performance.
  5. Following interruption, assess gas/drive alarms and operation count; gas handling and decomposition-product maintenance remain specialist work.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Puffer/self-blast variants establish gas flow differently; temperature-compensated density monitoring matters more than raw pressure alone.
  • SF6 is a potent greenhouse gas; leak detection, recovery and decomposition-product handling require trained specialists.No student gas release experiment is proposed.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

SF6 CB designed gas-flow/dielectric properties થી arc interrupt/recovery V withstand કરે છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Sealed pole, main/arcing conta cts, nozzle, chamber, drive, seals, density/relief parts.
  2. બંને પ્રકાર હોય તે design માં main/arcing conta cts normal/arc duty જુદી રાખે છે; nozzle gas ને hot arc પર લઈ જાય છે.
  3. Puffer cylinder mechanically gas compress કરે; self-blast arc energy પણ વાપરે એટલે pressure generation જુદું છે.
  4. Enclosure, seals, density monitor/relief dielectric condition જાળવે; monitor conta cts OEM alarm/block action સાથે મેળવો.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Open માં main થી arcing contact transfer/gas flow cool કરે.
  2. Zero એ gap recover; low density action OEM મુજબ, universal pressure નહીં.
  3. Mechanism ચાલતાં nozzle/chamber flow બનાવે; variant પ્રમાણે arc energy/mechanical compression કામ કરે.
  4. Cooled gap એ specified TRV માટે ઝડપથી recover થવું જોઈએ; density, purity/contact wear અસર કરે છે.
  5. Operation પછી gas/drive alarm/count જુઓ; gas/decomposition-product maintenance specialist નું કામ છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Puffer/self-blast flow જુદીરીતે; density compensation raw pressure કરતાંયોગ્ય.
  • SF6 potent greenhouse gas; leak/recovery/decomposition trained specialists થી; student gas release નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A vacuum circuit breaker interrupts current in a sealed high-vacuum interrupt er where contact metal-vapour arcing extinguishes and dielectric strength recovers rapidly near current zero.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Fixed/moving conta cts, metal bellows, sealed ceramic/metal envelope, vapour shield, external insulation and drive linkage.
  2. A hermetically sealed ceramic/metal envelope surrounds the contact gap; the bellows permits contact movement without intentionally admitting air.
  3. A vapour shield limits deposition on insulation surfaces; contact material/shape influences arc distribution and current chopping behaviour.
  4. External insulation, supports and mechanism remain necessary even when the internal gap is vacuum; sealed integrity and contact travel are verified by approved methods.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Separation forms a metal-vapour arc; around AC zero, vapour condenses and plasma disappears.
  2. Rapid dielectric recovery withstand s the specified recovery voltage; inspect wear/timing using approved OEM methods, not improvised high-voltage tests.
  3. The mechanism pulls the moving contact through the bellows; metal vapour sustains the arc rather than an ordinary air arc.
  4. At AC current zero, the metal vapour rapidly condenses onto conta cts/shields; the gap recovers a high dielectric strength.
  5. Inductive load switching may involve chopping/re ignition overvoltage; application-specific surge protection and ratings cannot be inferred from “vacuum”alone.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Vacuum does not mean “no arc”.Metal-vapour arc still exists during conduction; contact design controls arc distribution.
  • Common MV applications benefit from low medium maintenance, but contact wear, bellows integrity, mechanism timing, chopping/re ignition and applicable switching duty still matter.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Vacuum CB sealed high-vacuum interrupt er માં metal-vapour arc ને current zero નજીકબંધકરી rapid insulation recover કરે છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Fixed/movingconta cts, bellows, sealed envelope, vapour shield/drive.
  2. Hermetically sealed ceramic/metal envelope gap ને ઘેરે છે; bellows air પ્રવેશાવ્યા વિના movement આપે છે.
  3. Vapour shield insulation પર metal deposition ઘટાડે છે; contact material/shape arc distribution/chopping ને અસર કરે છે.
  4. અંદર vacuum હોવા છતાં external insulation/support/mechanism જોઈએ; sealed integrity/travel approved method થી verify કરાય છે.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Separation metal-vapour arc/AC zero એ vapour condense/plasma disappear.
  2. Rapidrecoveryrated V withstand; wear/timing OEM test થી, DIYHV નહીં.
  3. Mechanism bellows મારફતે moving contact ખેંચે; arc metal vapour થી ટકે છે, ordinary air arc નથી.
  4. AC current-zero પર vapour conta cts/shields પર ઝડપથી condense થઈ gap ની dielectric strength વધે છે.
  5. Inductive switching માં chopping/re ignition overvoltage થઈ શકે; માત્ર“vacuum”નામથી surge protection/rating નક્કી નથી.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Vacuum એટલે arc નથીએવુંનહીં; metal-vapour arc/contact design જરૂરી.
  • Common MV માં medium maintenance ઓછી; contact wear, bellows, timing/chopping/re ignition દ uty મહત્વનાં.

h.en: HVDC breaker: no natural periodic current zero
h.gu: HVDC Breaker: Natural Periodic Current Zero નથી

body.en:
Definition

An HV DC breaker is a DC fault-interrupting system that forces current interruption and absorbs/diverts network energy without relying on the periodic AC current zero.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Ahybrid concept has a low-loss normal-current path, commutation/semiconductor interruption path, fast isolating element and energy absorber such as a rated MOV bank.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Detect fault, com mutate current away from the normal path, establish sufficient opposing voltage and absorb stored/network-fed energy.
  2. Isolate the interrupted circuit and supervise voltage/current; detailed order/times depend on the chosen design.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Mechanical resonant-commutation, solid-state and hybrid designs have different speed, loss and cost; an ordinary AC breaker rating does not automatically apply to HVDC.
  • Fault current rises rapidly in low-inductance DC networks; detection, current limitation, commutation path, disconnecting element and absorber must coordinate.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Before effective interruption, an ideal inductive path gives di/dt≈V/L.With 100k Vand 50m H, slope≈2k A/ms.
  2. At 5k A, the same 50m H stores½LI²≈0.625 MJ; the absorber may additionally receive energy from sources, so this is not its final rating.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

HVDC breaker periodic AC zero વિના DC fault current interrupt/energy absorb-divert કરતી system છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Hybrid concept માં normal path, commutation/semiconductors, fast isola tor/energy MOV bank.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Fault detect/normal path થી com mutate/opposing V/energy store-network absorb.
  2. Interrupted circuit isolate/supervise; order/times design-specific.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Mechanical resonant, solid-state/hybrid ની speed-loss-cost જુદી; AC ratingautomatic HVDC માંનહીં.
  • Low LDC માં I ઝડપથીવધે; detection, limit, commutation, disconnect/absorber coordinate જોઈએ.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Ideal path માં di/dt≈V/L; 100k V/50m H થી≈2k A/ms.
  2. 5k A/50m H માં½LI²≈0.625 MJ; source energy પણઆવે, final rating નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Breaker selection matches insulation, continuous current, making/breaking, short-time withstand, operating sequence and recovery-voltage duties to the actual network and switching application.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Specify rated/highest voltage, frequency, insulation level, continuous current, RMS symmetrical breaking current, peak making current, short-time current/duration and operating duty.
  • DC offset depends on X/Rand contact-parting time; do not use one fixed peak multiplier for all networks.Cable/capacitor/reactor/transformer switching has special duties.
  • MV vacuum, LV air-break and HVSF 6/alternative-medium arrangements are common examples, not mandatory voltage rules.Check environmental, maintenance and available alternatives.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Illustrative three-phase interrupting apparent power Ssc=√3 VLLI sc.With 11k Vand 25k Arms, Ssc≈476.3 MVA.
  2. This legacy MVA expression does not replace k A, TRV, peak making, duration and sequence specifications.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Breakers election insulation, continuous I, make-break, short time, sequence/TRV દ uty ને actual network/application સાથે match કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Rated/highest V, f, insulation, continuous I, RMS breaking, peak making, short time/duration/sequence લખો.
  • DC offset X/R/contact time પર; universal peak multiplier નહીં; cable/capacitor/reactor/transformer duty અલગ.
  • MV vacuum/LV air/HVSF 6 common examples છે, mandatory rule નહીં; environment/maintenance/alternatives જુઓ.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Illustrative Ssc=√3 VLLI sc; 11k V/25k Arms થી≈476.3 MVA.
  2. Legacy MVA થી k A/TRV/peak/duration/sequence સ્પેસિફિકેશન replace નથીથતાં.

h.en: Project 5 · Group: Isola tor–CB–earth-switch interlock mock

body.en:
Definition

An interlock mock demonstrates permitted and blocked device-state transitions without operating any real switchgear or proving absence of voltage.

Classification / scope

  • Source group project; mock-only construction.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Plan safe scope and cite the source/materials; prepare SLD or logic before any approved isolated mock assembly.
  2. Review the result against function, selectivity, safety, evidence and stated limitations; submit only genuine completed work.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Build only isolated≤24 VDC current-limited indicators/buttons or offline logic; no relay output may connect to real plant controls.
  • Define valid CB, DS and ES states plus good/unknown status and a supervised “dead proved”mock input; unknown/bad input blocks transitions.
  • Disconnector moves only under the permitted no-load condition; ES close needs the approved isolation/dead conditions; CB close is blocked with ES closed or invalid DS state.
  • Test every illegal request, simultaneous commands, stale states, supply loss and reset; never teach automatic reclose onto a closed ES or a software-only substitute for prove-dead/earthing procedures.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Interlock mock actual switchgear ચાલાવ્યા/voltage absence prove કર્યાવિન apermitted/blocked transitions બતાવે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Source નો group project; construction માત્ર mock model માં.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Safe scope/source/materials નક્કી કરો; SLD/logic તૈયાર કર્યા પછી જ approved isolated mock બનાવો.
  2. Function, selectivity, safety, evidence/limitations સામે review કરો; ખરેખર કરેલું કામ જ submit કરો.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Isolated≤24 VDC indicators/buttons/offline logic જ; real plant controls સાથે output connect નહીં.
  • CB/DS/ES states+good/unknown+mock dead proved input define; bad/unknown માં block.
  • DS approved no-load માંજ; ES close માટે isolation/dead; ES closed/invalid DS માં CB close block.
  • Illegal/simultaneous/stale/supply loss/reset test; close d ES પર auto reclose/software થી prove-dead substitute ક્યારેયનહીં.

a.en: A properly rated CB interrupts specified load/fault currents.A disconnector provides isolation under permitted conditions and is not a substitute fault interrupt er; an open indicator alone is not proof of dead.
a.gu: Rated CB load/fault interrupt કરે; disconnector allowed condition માં isolation આપે, fault-breaker નથી; indicator થી prove-dead થતું નથી.

a.en: Contact separation under current ionises the medium and sustains a conducting path.Interruption requires current extinction plus sufficient dielectric recovery against the recovering voltage.
a.gu: Current વખતે conta cts જુદા પડતાં medium ionise થઈ conducting arc બને; current extinction સાથે dielectric recovery પૂરતી જોઈએ.

a.en: TRV is the early transient across conta cts after current interruption.Power-frequency recovery is the later system-frequency voltage; the rated system voltage alone does not define the TRV duty.
a.gu: TRV current interruption પછીનું શરૂઆતનું transient છે; later recovery system-frequency voltage છે; nominal voltage એકલું TRV duty નક્કી કરતું નથી.

a.en: An air-break design can use arc runners and splitter chutes in air.An air-blast design uses stored compressed air through a designed nozzle and therefore has different construction, pressure systems and maintenance.
a.gu: Air-break arc runners/splitter chute વાપરે; air-blast compressed-air nozzle/pressure system વાપરે એટલે construction/maintenance જુદાં.

q.en: Does a vacuum breaker have no arc?
q.gu: Vacuum CB માં arc બનતો નથી?

a.en: Metal vapour from conta cts sustains an arc in the vacuum envelope.Near current zero it condenses rapidly and dielectric strength recovers, subject to the interrupt er’s voltage/current/TRV capability.
a.gu: Contact metal-vapour arc બને છે; current-zero નજીક vapour condense થઈ dielectric strength પાછી આવે; rating/TRV limits યથાવત્ છે.

a.en: It is an effective interrupting/insulating gas but a strong greenhouse gas.Leak control, recovery, density supervision and safe treatment of decomposition pro du cts require trained approved procedures.
a.gu: Insulation/interruption સારું આપે પણ strong greenhouse gas છે; leak/recovery/density તથા decomposition pro du cts માટે trained procedure જોઈએ.

q.en: Why is HV DC interruption different?

a.en: DC does not provide a periodic natural current zero.ADC breaker must create suitable interruption/commutation conditions and manage inductive and continuing source energy; AC ratings cannot simply be reused.
a.gu: DC માં natural periodic current-zero નથી; commutation/forced interruption અને stored/source energy manage કરવી પડે; AC rating સીધી લાગુ નહીં.

q.en: Is breaking MVA a complete rating?

a.en: No.Individual RMS breaking current, peak making current, short-time withstand, insulation, TRV, sequence and control/mechanical duties are required.Legacy √3 VI converts one three-phase current/voltage pair only.
a.gu: નહીં.RMS break, peak make, short-time, insulation, TRV/sequence/control duty જોઈએ; √3 VI માત્ર legacy expression છે.
